annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于转发商务部、国家发展改革委《2025年稳外资行动方案》的通知
annotation.title_en: General Office of the State Council Notice Forwarding the Ministry of Commerce and NDRC "2025 Action Plan for Stabilizing Foreign Investment"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council of China); 商务部; 国家发展改革委
annotation.summary_en: China State Council General Office notice forwarding the 2025 Action Plan for Stabilizing Foreign Investment from the Ministry of Commerce and NDRC. It sets measures to expand opening, promote investment, strengthen open platforms and improve services for foreign-invested firms. It contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Expand pilot opening in telecom, healthcare, education and culture
Fully remove manufacturing foreign-access restrictions; shorten negative lists
Revise rules on foreign acquisitions of domestic enterprises
Establish standards so domestic-made products by all ownership types equally access government procurement
Strengthen free trade zones and development zones as foreign investment platforms
